# Copilot receiver lapses 8 h after process start (Entra login); the parent restarts it

<a id="body"></a>

## Body

A Copilot seat's native receiver lapses (receiver-lapsed, native-extension-unavailable; sends and reload asks are refused) exactly 8 h after the seat's process started. Copilot's Entra-derived login lasts 8 h from process start (prime confirmed 2026-11-21: otter 05:36:45 to 13:36:58; significant-silkworm and trout the same). It is not a pij bug. A plain restart renews it: pij send <seat> --command restart (Copilot /restart at idle with an empty composer, keeps the session). PA can't send it: tell the lapsed seat's recorded parent (pij-rs --json state <seat> | parent) to send it. If the seat has no live work, the parent can close it instead. Auto-restart for lapsed idle seats is waiting on Jordan's ruling; check RULINGS.md before acting differently.
